title: harness-audit
responsibility: Owns the harness-audit build or maintenance script.

errors.name: Harness audit command spawn failure
errors.description: Bun.spawnSync throws if its command cannot be started, for example when `bun` (HARNESS_CLI_PATH set) or `harness` (HARNESS_CLI_PATH unset) is not found on PATH. Nothing in this file catches that error, so the script stops before process.exit runs.
